# ESO KeePass Webhook Helm Chart

![Version: 0.1.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-0.1.0-informational?style=flat-square) ![Type: application](https://img.shields.io/badge/Type-application-informational?style=flat-square) ![AppVersion: 0.1.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/AppVersion-0.1.0-informational?style=flat-square)

Deploys [eso-keepass-webhook](https://github.com/steadforce/eso-keepass-webhook), which serves
entries from a KeePass database to the External Secrets Operator (ESO) webhook provider:

- the webhook (Deployment and Service), with the database mounted from a Secret
- an auth token, generated once by ESO
- a `ClusterSecretStore` named `keepass`

Requires ESO (tested with 2.12). The `ClusterSecretStore` and the auth token are only rendered when
the cluster serves ESO's APIs.

## Install

The chart mounts the database and its master password from an existing Secret:

```bash
kubectl create namespace keepass
kubectl -n keepass create secret generic keepass-database \
  --from-file=database.kdbx=./secrets.kdbx --from-file=password=./password.txt
helm install eso-keepass-webhook oci://ghcr.io/steadforce/charts/eso-keepass-webhook -n keepass
```

The password or key file can also live in a Secret of its own (`credentials.secretName`), while the
database comes from Git as below. A Secret is limited to 1 MiB, so keep the database small,
attachments included.

## Umbrella chart with Argo CD

```
external-secrets-deployment/
├── Chart.yaml
├── values.yaml
├── files/
│   └── cluster.kdbx            # edit in KeePassXC, commit
└── templates/
    ├── keepass-database.yaml
    └── keepass-credentials.yaml
```

```yaml
# Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
appVersion: &appVersion 2.12.0
name: &name external-secrets
version: *appVersion
dependencies:
- name: *name
  version: *appVersion
  repository: https://charts.external-secrets.io
- name: eso-keepass-webhook
  version: 0.1.0
  repository: oci://ghcr.io/steadforce/charts
  condition: eso-keepass-webhook.enabled
```

```yaml
# values.yaml
eso-keepass-webhook:
  enabled: true
  commonAnnotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "100"   # after ESO is running
  credentials:
    secretName: keepass-credentials
```

```yaml
# templates/keepass-database.yaml
{{- if index .Values "eso-keepass-webhook" "enabled" }}
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: keepass-database
type: Opaque
data:
  database.kdbx: {{ .Files.Get "files/cluster.kdbx" | b64enc }}
{{- end }}
```

```yaml
# templates/keepass-credentials.yaml: do not commit the real password in plain text
{{- if index .Values "eso-keepass-webhook" "enabled" }}
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: keepass-credentials
type: Opaque
stringData:
  password: <master password>
{{- end }}
```

## Development

The chart can be linted locally with the `chart-testing` tool:

```shell

```

To test the chart locally, you can use the `helm chart-testing` tool helm-unittest:
